title: Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A classic Thai dish featuring marinated chicken skewers grilled to perfection.

ingredients.name: infused oil
ingredients.notes: such as lemongrass or chili oil

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together infused oil, herb, and korean chili flakes.
Add the chicken cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot with your favorite Thai sides, such as rice or noodles.
